name: Universidade do Porto
summary: Public university in Porto; its School of Economics and Management (FEP) teaches Economics and Business Administration in English.

ib.text: EU students from foreign systems apply through the national contest, on its deadlines: IB grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%; at least 12 of 20 per exam (2026 criteria).

programmes.name: Bachelor in Economics (taught in English)
programmes.about: Economics with management, quantitative methods, law and accounting, taught in English; the third year adds electives from FEP and across the University of Porto (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, plus a second exam such as English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 11 of 20 overall and 12 of 20 per exam. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Administration (taught in English)
programmes.about: Business and economics with social sciences, law, maths and information management, plus courses on personal and social skills; taught in English (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, plus a second exam such as English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 11 of 20 overall and 12 of 20 per exam. 2026 criteria.

notes: FEP's international-student calls are for non-EU applicants; EU/EEA students from foreign systems use the national contest.
Each English degree is its own national-contest course, separate from the Portuguese one, and has no published cut-off yet.
The rest of U.Porto's 50-plus bachelor's and integrated master's are taught in Portuguese.
